question_record.context: A security report indicates that emails containing a malicious URL were delivered to raphaelt@vnevado.alpineskihouse.co from alyssat@vnevado.alpineskihouse.co, connected to Nina Park, and were subsequently removed after delivery; the malicious URL was https://ms175052280.orangecliff-f53f26fd.eastus.azurecontainerapps.io.
question_record.question: Can you identify the URL that was detected as potentially malicious according to the recent alert?
solution: The email account `Nina Park@vnevado.alpineskihouse.co` received an email with a malicious URL.
A user clicked on the malicious URL `http://ms175052280.orangecliff-f53f26fd.eastus.azurecontainerapps.io/`.

       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'Account_Derived_Email'
